DeepShield-Vision

A proposed deepfake-detection comparison between CNN and Vision Transformer methods for manipulated-image detection.

PROJECT STATUS

Blueprint prepared

ROLE

Independent project developer (planned)

TECHNOLOGIES

Python · PyTorch

Scope

This project is a planned research-oriented comparison of convolutional neural networks and Vision Transformer architectures for detecting manipulated images.

What is available now

The project has a defined concept and blueprint. There are currently no published training runs, performance metrics, source repository, deployed demonstration, or verified benchmark results.

Planned methodology

Future work will document dataset licensing and splits, model configurations, evaluation metrics, baseline comparisons, computational constraints, and limitations. Any published result will include evidence and reproducibility context.

Publication policy

Until implementation and review are complete, this project remains clearly marked as on hold. It should not be interpreted as a completed model, credential, or deployed security product.
